content: If your child is taking this medication on a regular schedule and misses a dose, administer the missed dose as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of the next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with the next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from moisture, heat, and direct light. Do not freeze the medication. Avoid storing it in the bathroom, as the humidity can affect its stability. Do not dispose of this medication by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations or your healthcare provider's guidance. This information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that the information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. This summary does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. It is not intended to replace individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this medication and to address your specific health needs.
